youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for the prayers still on blank pages.

She: Jesus... I found my old prayer journal tonight. 📔
She: Two years of requests. So many pages still blank. I almost stopped hoping.
Jesus: A blank page isn't a refused prayer. Some promises carry dates you can't see yet.
She: But what if the answer never comes? Those pages just hurt to read.
Jesus: What I promise, I perform. Hope trusts the Author isn't done writing.
Jesus: Bring the journal back out. Not to count blanks. To see how far you've come.
